queries.name: inverse-related
queries.sql: SELECT b."B-label" AS label, RELATED_KEYS(b."B-A", 2) AS related FROM B b

queries.name: equality-join
queries.sql: SELECT b."B-label" AS left_label, c."B-value" AS right_value FROM B b JOIN B c ON b."B-value" = c."B-value"

queries.name: record-count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM B b
